anchor_control.interpretation: Unchanged skate source is a control anchor. Show both player counts, repeated-run ranges, tail latency and whole-suite drift before attributing ski changes.

renderer.scope: Real renderer first/middle/last uploaded MultiMesh transform readback, all four maps. Course is not added to the scene tree; does not establish rendered LOD transitions or visual acceptance.

statistics.statistics_method: Frozen bench.summarize_samples over pooled original frames: time-weighted FPS, R7 quantiles, worst-tail 1% low. Do not average three percentiles. Three independent run identities per side; adjacent frames are correlated.
limitations: A full before block precedes a full after block; no randomization or locked thermal/frequency state.
Balanced; normal desktop remains available. Repeat ranges and skate anchors do not remove all thermal/background bias.
Sampler lacks actual per-player viewport dimension/AA/scale snapshots; null means not collected.
CPU TIME_PROCESS is engine process time, not OS utilization. Per-viewport GPU timers are last available render work and are never added into whole-frame GPU time.

statistics.decision: No automatic acceptance from fewer triangles or PASS status. Root reviews repeated-run evidence and pending real-scene visuals; inconclusive or regressing optimization requires another scoped candidate, not a done claim.

interpretation: Historical measurements at the recorded source commits; no consistent overall benefit accepted. Latest dev merge is not a new measurement.

environment.ac_check: Every hidden helper polled once per second without an AC-loss/unknown-power failure; all endpoints online.
environment.desktop: Hidden non-input rendering desktop; normal user desktop remained available.
